name: Isaac Thompson

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Mary Gardiner, daughter of Col. Abraham Gardiner and Mary Smith (a Bull Smith descendant).

bioAdditions: Son of Jonathan Thompson (1710-86) and Mary Woodhull, grandson of Samuel Thompson (S2): 2nd cousin 9 times removed via John Thompson. Magistrate for more than forty years, judge of common pleas and assemblyman (S1). His wife made their children Bull Smith cousins too.

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. p. 470
